name: ExpandableCardGrid
summary: A row of glassmorphic cards that reveal together, then each card expands into focus in turn (scales up + reveals a detail paragraph) while siblings dim. Continuous background orb drift keeps the frame alive for deterministic capture.
bestFor: Explaining a small set (2-5) of related items one at a time — file anatomy, rule sets, do/don't lists, capability tiers — where the active item should grow and reveal more detail as narration discusses it.

subtitle.description: Short supporting line under the title.

cards.description: 2-5 cards. Each is focused in array order, evenly spread across the scene duration.

icon.description: Single emoji or 1-2 char glyph shown in the accent chip.

detail.description: Longer explanation revealed when the card expands into focus. Supports <b> for accent emphasis.

accent.description: Optional per-card CSS accent color; defaults to props.accentColor.

cards.label: ID card
cards.detail: Declares the marker and the inputs the assistant can read.

cards.label: Brain
cards.detail: Embeds the mapping and reviewer lookup so no external call is needed.

cards.label: Trigger
cards.detail: Path filters gate whether the skill runs at all.
